webhooks.signingHelp: Each delivery is signed as Standard Webhooks specifies: the headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature. If the receiver answers 410, Zenbree stops sending and marks the webhook as revoked by the receiver. It stays listed, with its history, until you delete it.
webhooks.deleteBody: The receiver gets no more events from Zenbree.
webhooks.deleteBullet1: Deliveries waiting to be retried are dropped
webhooks.deleteBullet2: Its delivery history is deleted: add the webhook again to get a new secret
webhooks.historyHelp: The latest attempts, newest first. A retry repeats the event ID, so your receiver must ignore an ID it already handled. Payloads are never stored here.
webhooks.revokedHelp: The receiver answered 410 Gone, so Zenbree stopped sending. Delete the webhook, then add it again if you want deliveries back.
